content: Ayush Pande repurposed an Acer Predator Helios 300 laptop as a Proxmox server for home-server experiments. Although the laptop performs well, its non-removable battery created a major problem for continuous operation and battery health. He addressed it by building a Home Assistant automation pipeline and using a $9 smart plug to manage the laptop’s power.

Right-wing commentator Sydney Watson falsely implied that WNBA player Brittney Griner is a man, claiming the league may avoid defining “woman” because one already plays in it. The remark, shared on X, came amid a broader anti-transgender sports campaign promoted by MAGA figures, Donald Trump and some female athletes. Former University of Kentucky swimmer Riley Gaines became a leading activist after tying with transgender competitor Lia Thomas at a 2022 NCAA championship, while Indiana Fever player Sophie Cunningham has also embraced the movement.

Bearded capuchin monkeys in northeastern Brazil hunt and eat small vertebrates more often when fruit is scarce. Researchers led by Noemi Spagnoletti analyzed more than 5,000 hours of observations collected from June 2006 to December 2010, documenting the monkeys’ consumption of lizards, snakes and iguanas. The findings, reported August 26 in PLOS One, could offer insights into the early evolution of human diets and the shift toward greater meat consumption.

Вона призначена для виявлення, ідентифікації та нейтралізації безпілотників вагою до 150 кг, прикриваючи стаціонарні об’єкти, зокрема базу майбутніх винищувачів F-35. Right-wing commentator Sydney Watson shared a video of WNBA player Brittney Griner and speculated, without evidence, that the league already had a man playing in it; Griner is a cisgender woman. The claim comes amid a wider anti-transgender campaign around women’s sports, promoted by figures including Donald Trump, former swimmer Riley Gaines, and Indiana Fever player Sophie Cunningham. The article describes the accusation as part of a moral panic targeting transgender women in sports.

Bearded capuchin monkeys in northeastern Brazil hunted and ate small vertebrates—including lizards, snakes and iguanas—more often when fruit was less abundant, according to a study published August 26 in *PLOS One*. Researchers led by Noemi Spagnoletti analyzed observations collected from June 2006 to December 2010, totaling more than 5,000 hours, and compared the monkeys’ diets with seasonal plant-food availability and other environmental and demographic factors. The findings may offer clues about the evolution of early human diets and the shift toward eating more meat.

Ayush Pande repurposed an old Acer Predator Helios 300 laptop as a Proxmox server, but its non-easily removable battery created a problem for home server use. He says Proxmox’s lightweight design makes old x86 machines, including laptops like his 2014 Lenovo G510, useful for self-hosting instead of becoming e-waste. To address the Predator’s battery issue, he built a Home Assistant automation pipeline using a $9 smart plug.

It also notes that WNBA player Sophie Cunningham of the Indiana Fever has increasingly aligned herself with that movement.

Bearded capuchin monkeys in northeastern Brazil hunt and eat small vertebrates more often when fruit is scarce, researchers reported August 26 in PLOS One. Zoologist Noemi Spagnoletti of Sapienza University of Rome and colleagues analyzed more than 5,000 hours of observations collected from June 2006 to December 2010. The monkeys were seen hunting and consuming animals including lizards, snakes and iguanas, and researchers compared those behaviors with seasonal plant food availability, environmental factors, and the monkeys’ age and sex. The findings may offer insight into the early evolution of human diets and the shift toward eating more meat.

PC hardware and gaming writer Ayush Pande published an article on August 26, 2026, detailing his experience repurposing older x86 machines, such as a 2014 Lenovo G510 and an Acer Predator Helios 300, into low-power Proxmox VE nodes. He identifies the non-removable battery on the Acer Predator Helios 300 as the biggest issue when using a recycled laptop for home server tasks. Pande constructed a Home Assistant automation pipeline integrated with a $9 smart plug to resolve this power management problem. The article explains how this setup overcomes the limitations inherent in repurposing laptops with built-in batteries for continuous server operation.

Right-wing Australian YouTuber Sydney Watson, who has over a million X followers, posted Monday speculation that a man may already play in the WNBA after sharing a 2024 video of Connecticut Sun center Brittney Griner. Watson suggested the league refuses to define “woman” and explicitly exclude men because “there is already a man ... in the league,” despite Griner being a cisgender woman. The report situates this comment amid a moral panic about transgender women in sports that it says has been ginned up by MAGA figures, Donald Trump, and athletes such as Riley Gaines and Indiana Fever’s Sophie Cunningham. Although the article asserts there are no transgender women in the WNBA, it labels Watson’s remarks baseless and inflammatory.

Bearded capuchin monkeys (Sapajus libidinosus) in northeastern Brazil hunt and consume small vertebrates more often when fruit is scarce, according to a study reported August 26 in PLOS One. Zoologist Noemi Spagnoletti of Sapienza University of Rome and her colleagues analyzed more than 5,000 hours of observations collected between June 2006 and December 2010, correlating meat-eating habits with seasonal plant food availability, temperature, and the age and sex of the monkeys. “We repeatedly observed the monkeys actively hunting and consuming vertebrates, including lizards, snakes and iguanas,” Spagnoletti said. The findings may help researchers understand the early evolution of human diets and the lineage’s shift to meatier fare.
